captionBasis: both forms name every field with a bare number, so every caption was read from the form's own content stream at a recorded coordinate; captionReadAt records where, and the build refuses if a caption is no longer printed there. Viewer buttons carry their labels in their own appearance streams and are exempt from the drift check.
